messages:
Leah (People Ops): Following up from today's all-hands Q&A — posting concise notes on promotions, comp bands, and timelines. Will update with questions.

Jordan (Eng): Are US market adjustments happening this quarter or next?

Marco (Comp): Targeted US adjustments this quarter. EMEA review scheduled for Q3. We'll notify teams before any changes are applied.

Samira (IC3): If someone is on a PIP, can they be considered for promotion?

Leah (People Ops): Typically no. Promotions paused until performance sustained post-PIP. Exceptions require Exec sign-off.

Jordan (Eng): Managers need a checklist for calibration packets.

Leah (People Ops): Checklist: role summary, 3 impact bullets, manager rationale, peer feedback, proposed level & comp. Template uploaded.

Marco (Comp): Note on merit vs market: merits are performance-based; market is band alignment. We avoid applying both to the same person without review.

Jordan (Eng): When are submissions due?

Leah (People Ops): Manager packets due May 8 EOD PT. Calibration panels May 15–16. Final approvals by May 22. Appeals open 14 days after manager conversation.

Samira (IC3): If approved, when does pay change go into effect?

Marco (Comp): Salary effective first full pay period after approvals (usually within 1–2 pay cycles). Retro only for admin error or board-approved cases.

hr-bot: Templates & notes: https://redwoodinference.notion.site/Promo-Calibration-1771804321

Leah (People Ops): Office hours next week for managers & ICs — sign-up in Notion. DM us for urgent one-offs. :thumbsup:
